scope: Honor paused-clock native focus callbacks, imported layer name and hidden-canvas timer display semantics; record manual contrast inputs

edits.name: Record computed control styles for manual native dropdown contrast review
edits.old: controls: Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('button,select')).filter(visible).map(node => ({ name: node.getAttribute('aria-label') || node.textContent, ...box(node), font: parseFloat(getComputedStyle(node).fontSize), clipped: node.scrollWidth > node.clientWidth + 1 })),
edits.new: controls: Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('button,select')).filter(visible).map(node => { const style = getComputedStyle(node); return { name: node.getAttribute('aria-label') || node.textContent, ...box(node), font: parseFloat(style.fontSize), clipped: node.scrollWidth > node.clientWidth + 1, color: style.color, backgroundColor: style.backgroundColor, backgroundImage: style.backgroundImage, backgroundPosition: style.backgroundPosition, backgroundSize: style.backgroundSize }; }),

edits.name: Flush native render-dependent focus timer before first Keep focus assertion
edits.old: await restart(page).focus(); await page.keyboard.press('Enter'); await expect(review(page)).toBeVisible(); await expect(keep(page)).toBeFocused();
edits.new: await restart(page).focus(); await page.keyboard.press('Enter'); await expect(review(page)).toBeVisible(); await page.clock.runFor(1); await expect(keep(page)).toBeFocused();

edits.name: Use the imported native STEM module layer name in restart scope disclosure
edits.old: toContainText('resets the technique attempt for External Anatomy')
edits.new: toContainText('resets the technique attempt for Skin')

edits.name: Flush native return-focus timer after Escape before reopening review
edits.old: await page.keyboard.press('Escape'); await expect(review(page)).toHaveCount(0); await expect(restart(page)).toBeFocused(); expect(await proof(page)).toEqual(before);
edits.new: await page.keyboard.press('Escape'); await expect(review(page)).toHaveCount(0); await page.clock.runFor(1); await expect(restart(page)).toBeFocused(); expect(await proof(page)).toEqual(before);

edits.name: Flush Keep focus and cancellation return-focus callbacks under the paused clock
edits.old: await page.keyboard.press('Space'); await expect(keep(page)).toBeFocused(); await page.keyboard.press('Enter'); await expect(review(page)).toHaveCount(0); await expect(restart(page)).toBeFocused(); expect(await proof(page)).toEqual(before);
edits.new: await page.keyboard.press('Space'); await expect(review(page)).toBeVisible(); await page.clock.runFor(1); await expect(keep(page)).toBeFocused(); await page.keyboard.press('Enter'); await expect(review(page)).toHaveCount(0); await page.clock.runFor(1); await expect(restart(page)).toBeFocused(); expect(await proof(page)).toEqual(before);

edits.name: Flush the final review request and retain Keep-first focus before confirmation
edits.old: await page.keyboard.press('Enter'); await expect(review(page)).toBeVisible(); await confirm(page).focus(); await consolePanel(page).screenshot
edits.new: await page.keyboard.press('Enter'); await expect(review(page)).toBeVisible(); await page.clock.runFor(1); await expect(keep(page)).toBeFocused(); await confirm(page).focus(); await consolePanel(page).screenshot

edits.name: Assert native hidden challenge display pauses while its absolute deadline stays fixed
edits.old: await page.clock.runFor(2200); const running = await state(page); expect(running.practicalTimer).toBeLessThan(120); expect(running.scenarioTimeRemaining).toBeLessThan(240); expect(running.practicalEndsAt).toBe(active.practicalEndsAt); expect(running.scenarioStartedAt).toBe(challenge.scenarioStartedAt);

edits.name: Verify resumed native challenge counter catches up to elapsed deadline after End and panel reopening
edits.old:
await expect(consolePanel(page)).toBeVisible();
  const afterTimed = await proof(page); await harness.unmount(page);

edits.name: Record hidden and resumed challenge display values alongside unchanged deadlines and saved work
edits.old: runningSeconds: { technique: running.scenarioTimeRemaining, identification: running.practicalTimer }, before, afterTimed
edits.new: runningSeconds: { hiddenTechniqueDisplay: running.scenarioTimeRemaining, identification: running.practicalTimer, resumedTechniqueDisplay: resumed.scenarioTimeRemaining }, challengeDeadline: challenge.scenarioStartedAt + 240000, before, afterTimed
